name: Lighting Prediction Network Training
aliases: Hybrid Loss Training for Lighting Prediction
definition: A training strategy using a weighted sum of multiple loss terms to predict lighting for street scenes, addressing depth rendering ambiguity and encouraging photorealism via adversarial supervision.
summary: Lighting Prediction Network Training is a two-stage strategy using hybrid loss and adversarial supervision to predict street scene lighting, distinguishing itself by addressing depth ambiguity and encouraging photorealism.
